title: Add grocery items and social media link sharing to chat

requirements.summary: Update the useSendMessage mutation hook to support sending messages with messageType, groceryItems array, and socialMediaUrl parameters
acceptanceCriteria: Hook accepts optional groceryItems and socialMediaUrl in mutation variables
Hook properly serializes grocery items array and social media URL for backend
Mutation invalidates message queries after successful send

file_operations.description: Extend the useSendMessage mutation hook to accept messageType, groceryItems (array of strings), and socialMediaUrl (string) as optional parameters in the mutation variables. Update the mutation function to call actor.sendMessage with these new parameters, passing null for groceryItems/socialMediaUrl when not provided. Ensure the mutation continues to invalidate ['messages'] query key after successful send.

requirements.summary: Add a grocery list composer UI in the Chat page that allows users to add multiple grocery items to a list with an input field and add/remove buttons, then send the complete list as a single message
acceptanceCriteria: Users can type grocery item names and add them to a temporary list
UI shows all items in the current grocery list with remove buttons
A 'Send Grocery List' button sends all items as a single groceryList message
The grocery list UI clears after successful send

file_operations.description: Add a grocery list composer section to the Chat page. Include local state to manage a temporary array of grocery items (strings). Add an input field for typing grocery item names with an 'Add Item' button that appends the item to the temporary list. Display all items in the list with individual remove buttons. Add a 'Send Grocery List' button that calls the useSendMessage mutation with messageType 'groceryList' and the groceryItems array, then clears the temporary list on success. Position this UI in the message composition area, visible when the grocery list message type is selected.

requirements.summary: Add a social media link input field in the Chat page that accepts URLs and sends them as socialMediaLink messages with basic URL validation
acceptanceCriteria: Input field accepts text URLs
Basic validation checks for valid URL format (http/https)
A 'Send Link' button sends the URL as a socialMediaLink message
Input clears after successful send

file_operations.description: Add a social media link input section to the Chat page. Include an input field for entering URLs with local state management. Implement basic client-side validation to check that the URL starts with 'http://' or 'https://'. Add a 'Send Link' button that calls the useSendMessage mutation with messageType 'socialMediaLink' and the socialMediaUrl parameter when validation passes. Clear the input field after successful send. Display validation error messages when the URL format is invalid. Position this UI in the message composition area, visible when the social media link message type is selected.

requirements.summary: Update the message display logic in Chat.tsx to render grocery list messages as formatted lists with checkboxes or bullet points showing all items in the groceryItems array
acceptanceCriteria: Grocery list messages display with a distinct visual style (e.g., card or bordered section)
Each grocery item appears as a list item with checkbox or bullet point
The message shows the sender and timestamp like regular messages

file_operations.description: Update the message rendering logic in Chat.tsx to conditionally render grocery list messages. When message.messageType is 'groceryList', display the message with a distinct card or bordered visual style. Map over message.groceryItems array and render each item as a list entry with a checkbox or bullet point. Include the sender name (fetched from user profile) and timestamp in the message header, consistent with regular text messages. Use Tailwind CSS classes to style the grocery list message differently from text messages (e.g., bg-green-50 border-green-200 for light mode).

requirements.summary: Update the message display logic in Chat.tsx to render social media link messages with link preview cards showing the URL as a clickable hyperlink that opens in a new tab
acceptanceCriteria: Social media link messages display with a distinct visual style (e.g., card with link icon)
URL is rendered as a clickable link with target='_blank' and rel='noopener noreferrer'
The message shows the sender and timestamp like regular messages
Link preview card includes visual indication that it's a link (icon, underline, or distinct styling)

file_operations.description: Update the message rendering logic in Chat.tsx to conditionally render social media link messages. When message.messageType is 'socialMediaLink', display the message as a card with distinct styling (e.g., bg-blue-50 border-blue-200). Render message.socialMediaUrl as a clickable hyperlink with target='_blank' and rel='noopener noreferrer' for security. Include a link icon (from lucide-react or similar) next to the URL. Include the sender name and timestamp in the message header, consistent with regular messages. Apply visual indicators that it's a clickable link (underline, icon, hover effects).

requirements.summary: Add a message type selector or toggle buttons in the Chat page UI that allows users to switch between sending regular text messages, grocery lists, and social media links
acceptanceCriteria: UI provides clear options to select message type (text, grocery list, social media link)
Selecting a message type shows the appropriate input interface
The selected message type is visually indicated
Users can easily switch between message types

file_operations.description: Add a message type selector UI component to the Chat page above the message composition area. Implement three toggle buttons or radio buttons labeled 'Text Message', 'Grocery List', and 'Social Media Link'. Use local state to track the currently selected message type. Apply distinct styling to visually indicate the active selection (e.g., bg-primary text-white for selected, bg-gray-100 for unselected). When a message type is selected, conditionally render the appropriate input interface: the existing text input for 'Text Message', the grocery list composer for 'Grocery List', and the URL input for 'Social Media Link'. Ensure smooth transitions between message type selections.
